description:
[Knowledge base] Upload and process a knowledge base document (base64 file). The optional interview_ids limits it to chosen interviews on the same knowledge base: leave it out for every interview, [] for none. Returns the limit it set.

Uploads a document to a knowledge base store and queues it for processing. Accepts the file either as multipart/form-data (binary `file`) or as application/json (base64 `file`). Use `interview_ids` to limit the document to chosen interviews.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

interview_ids.description: The interviews that may use this document, in the live session and when generating questions. Omit it or send null to use the document in every interview on the knowledge base. An empty list limits it to no interview. Each interview must belong to the same company and use this knowledge base. With multipart/form-data, repeat the field or send one JSON array such as `["<id>"]`, and write an empty list as `[]`.

knowledge_base_store_id.description: The knowledge base store to add the document to.

name.description: Document name (with extension). Falls back to the uploaded file name for multipart.

name: upload_knowledge_base_document

interview_ids.description: The interviews this document is limited to. Present only when `limit_to_interviews` is true; an empty list means no interview can use it.

knowledge_base_id.description: Id of the created knowledge_base record.

limit_to_interviews.description: True when the document is limited to the interviews in `interview_ids`. False when every interview on the knowledge base can use it.

title: Upload knowledge base document
